description: Deribit BTC or ETH options for one expiry (default: nearest unexpired): at-the-money implied volatility (mark IV), and an IV skew at ±10% moneyness (put at 0.9x spot minus call at 1.1x spot, in IV points). This is a moneyness skew, not a 25-delta skew: Deribit's summary has no delta, so per-strike delta calls are not made. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

expiry.description: Expiry as Deribit writes it, e.g. 30OCT26 (optional; default nearest)
